To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ensemble methodology that constructs diverse classifiers using a pairwise adversarially robust loss function during the training achieves high clean example accuracy and robustness against black-box transfer and white-box adversarial attacks.

our proposed PARL ensemble methodology achieves higher clean example accuracy and higher robustness against adversarial attacks compared to state-of-the-art ensemble methods, including the recently proposed adversarially trained ensembles.

we propose a new ensemble methodology called PARL, which utilizes gradients of each classifier within the ensemble, and demonstrate its effectiveness against adversarial attacks in black-box settings.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new ensemble methodology against adversarial attacks that constructs multiple diverse models using PARL function.
the development of a new ensemble methodology for robust classification against black-box transfer and white-box attacks.
developing a new ensemble methodology to enhance the diversity of classifiers in the ensemble and thereby improving the robustness of ensemble against adversarial attacks.

the proposed PARL ensemble method is more robust against adversarial attacks than previous ensemble methods.
our proposed ensemble methodology achieves a high clean accuracy with higher robustness against adversarial attacks.
our proposed PARL is the best ensemble method for adversarial robustness against transfer attacks and is also competitive against white-box attacks.

PARL is the first ensemble methodology to be robust against stronger adversaries with higher clean example accuracy.
the proposed PARL is a simple yet effective approach to construct diverse classifiers to resist adversarial attacks.
we propose an ensemble training procedure that can be used to construct a diverse classifier that can be used against transfer attacks.

the proposed ensemble method achieves higher robustness with higher clean example accuracy against both black-box transfer attacks and white-box attacks.
